name: openviking-memory
description: Long-term semantic memory for Kimi Code CLI, powered by OpenViking. Community implementation, not an official Kimi Code plugin. Recall on UserPromptSubmit, incremental capture (user text, assistant text, tool calls/results) on Stop/PreCompact/SessionEnd/Interrupt, pending replay on SessionStart, with a local stdio MCP proxy. Windows-safe: no detached background workers.

interface.shortDescription: Recall and capture long-term memory through OpenViking
interface.longDescription: Hooks Kimi Code's lifecycle to keep an external semantic memory: recall relevant memories on each UserPromptSubmit (raw stdout injection); decode the session wire.jsonl incrementally on Stop/PreCompact/SessionEnd/Interrupt and append user/assistant/tool messages to a long-lived OpenViking session keyed kc-<session-id>; commit on SessionEnd/PreCompact and by threshold; replay a bounded pending queue on SessionStart. Exposes OpenViking's MCP tools through a local stdio proxy. All hooks run synchronously (no detached workers) for Windows reliability.
